unverified_boundaries: Agent routing and interactive behavior have not been runtime-evaluated.
Scientific benchmark performance has not been established.
Human-expert review has not been performed.
Large quantification tables, vendor-specific exports, and complex quantitative objects have not been runtime-evaluated.
Bioconductor, QFeatures, and MSstats execution was skipped; no normalization, imputation, or statistical model was run.
Raw-MS processing, identification/FDR, protein inference, and differential-abundance behavior are outside this package.

decision_sequence.applies_when: The row-level entity is absent, mixed, or ambiguous.
decision_sequence.question: Does each row represent a peptide, protein group, or protein?
decision_sequence.recommended_answer: Use one declared peptide- or protein-level boundary and route PSM or mixed-level inputs elsewhere.

decision_sequence.applies_when: Blank, missing, zero, negative, or censored-value semantics are undocumented.
decision_sequence.question: What do blank, zero, negative, and censored values mean in this export?
decision_sequence.recommended_answer: Preserve and document the producer's semantics before any recoding, normalization, or imputation decision.

decision_sequence.applies_when: Sample columns, join keys, conditions, replicates, batches, or the intended contrast are unresolved.
decision_sequence.question: Which fields define the sample join, conditions, biological replicates, batches, and intended contrast?
decision_sequence.recommended_answer: Freeze a one-to-one sample join and verify replication and confounding before downstream modeling.

runtime_verification.reason: The package is instruction-only. Large-table execution and optional R/Bioconductor quantitative-proteomics adapters require complex tooling and were deliberately not run.
